records.title: Demystifying the Token Dynamics of Deep Selective State Space Models
records.reason: The paper analyzes Mamba token dynamics and proposes refinements for model performance. Full text concerns theory and model-quality experiments, without a demonstrated inference latency, memory or throughput gain for Jamba-like serving.

records.title: On Exact Bit-level Reversible Transformers Without Changing Architectures
records.reason: BDIA reversibility is motivated/evaluated to save backpropagation training memory. The paper says inference uses an otherwise unchanged Transformer up to activation quantization and reports no inference-memory/serving gain.

records.title: Dimensionality Reduction on Complex Vector Spaces for Euclidean Distance with Dynamic Weights
records.reason: This is a Johnson–Lindenstrauss-style weighted-distance projection result, not a language model, inference system or model-compression/serving method.
